experiment_section: Randomized Response (RR) Treatment – Agent-Monitor Dyad Game

instructions.description: Instructions explaining sender's decision screen (message to reporter: 'I will not reduce the profit' or 'I will reduce the profit if my project is blocked') and reporter's evaluation screen (block or not block project), with screenshots of both interfaces

Instructions explaining the unrelated question (randomized response technique, 25% probability of being asked 'do you see the word red?'), importance note about sender uncertainty regarding why project was blocked, and payoff consequences of implemented vs blocked good/bad projects

Instructions showing end-of-round feedback screen screenshot (summary of implemented/blocked projects, total return, sender and reporter profits) and a worked scenario (Case 1) with profit calculations for sender and reporter when bad project is implemented

Social learning additional section: explains conditional payoff information from previous participants (80 subjects), with screenshot of sender's screen showing average profit table by project quality (Bad/Good) and decision (reduce profit or not)

Social learning additional section continued: screenshot of reporter's conditional payoff information screen showing two cases (sender reduces profit or not) by project quality (Bad/Good) and blocking decision; remark that in RR treatment the conditional payoff information is displayed separately for the unrelated question case

screens.description: Reporter's evaluation screen: informed of project quality (Bad) and sender's message ('I will reduce the profit if my project is blocked'), then asked 'Would you like to block the project?' (Yes / No)

parameters.sender_message_shown: I will reduce the profit if my project is blocked
